content.description: A QA Engineer (Kiểm thử phần mềm) is responsible for making sure software works correctly before and after release — designing test plans, writing and executing test cases (manual and/or automated), logging and tracking defects, and working with developers and product managers to define what "quality" means for a given feature. The role spans two overlapping tracks: manual/functional testing (exploring the product like a user would, validating requirements) and automation testing (writing code/scripts that run tests automatically as part of the development pipeline). Unlike a Developer, whose main output is production code, a QA Engineer's main output is confidence that the code behaves as intended — through test coverage, bug reports, and quality processes.

vnMarket.value: Automation Testing đang ngày càng được doanh nghiệp Việt Nam ưu tiên trong tuyển dụng Tester/QA, song song với kỹ năng manual testing truyền thống; nhiều nhà tuyển dụng cũng đánh giá cao các chứng chỉ kiểm thử quốc tế như ISTQB, ASTQB, CSTE khi xét ứng viên cho các vị trí Senior Tester, Test Lead/QA Lead trở lên.

salary.value: Mức lương trung vị của Tester tại Việt Nam là khoảng 28,8 triệu VNĐ/tháng (dưới 1 năm: ~14,15tr; 1-2 năm: ~14,2tr; 3-4 năm: ~20,7tr; 5-8 năm: ~25,3tr; trên 8 năm: ~36,5tr); QA-QC là khoảng 31,2 triệu VNĐ/tháng (1-2 năm: ~18tr; 3-4 năm: ~24,4tr; 5-8 năm: ~29,75tr; trên 8 năm: ~38,5tr) — theo ITviec IT Salary & Recruitment Market Report 2025-2026 (khảo sát 1.839 người).

demand.value: VietnamWorks hiện có hơn 400 việc làm QC Tester/QA đang tuyển (cập nhật liên tục, ghi nhận 424 vị trí tại thời điểm truy cập), cho thấy nhu cầu tuyển dụng nhân sự kiểm thử phần mềm tại Việt Nam vẫn ở mức cao và ổn định.

similarJobs.name: Automation Test Engineer
similarJobs.distinction: Specializes in writing and maintaining automated test scripts/frameworks, versus a general QA Engineer who typically balances manual and automated testing.

similarJobs.name: Business Analyst
similarJobs.distinction: Focuses on gathering and documenting business requirements rather than verifying that the built product meets those requirements.

similarJobs.name: SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)
similarJobs.distinction: Writes production-grade code for test infrastructure/tooling, closer to a developer role, versus a QA Engineer's broader test-design and quality-process focus.

similarJobs.name: DevOps Engineer
similarJobs.distinction: Focuses on CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation rather than designing test cases and validating functional/non-functional requirements.

hardSkills.name: Test case design & test planning
hardSkills.description: Translating requirements into concrete, traceable test cases and a coverage plan is the core deliverable of the role.

hardSkills.name: Manual/functional testing
hardSkills.description: Exploring the application like a real user to catch usability and functional issues that scripted tests may miss.

hardSkills.name: Automation testing (Selenium, Cypress, or similar) & scripting
hardSkills.description: Writing automated test scripts (often in Java, Python, or JavaScript) to run regression tests continuously as the product changes.

hardSkills.name: SQL & database validation
hardSkills.description: Many defects trace back to incorrect data, so querying and verifying database state is a routine part of testing.

hardSkills.name: API testing (Postman or similar)
hardSkills.description: Modern applications rely heavily on APIs, so validating requests, responses, and edge cases at the API layer is essential.

hardSkills.name: Bug tracking & Agile tools (Jira)
hardSkills.description: QA Engineers log, prioritize, and track defects through their lifecycle alongside developers and product owners.

softSkills.name: Attention to detail
softSkills.description: Catching subtle inconsistencies and edge cases is what separates effective testing from a superficial pass.

softSkills.name: Clear communication & bug reporting
softSkills.description: A bug report must give developers enough detail (steps, environment, expected vs. actual) to reproduce and fix the issue quickly.

softSkills.name: Critical / analytical thinking
softSkills.description: Good testers think adversarially about a feature — anticipating how it could break rather than just confirming it works as expected.

softSkills.name: Patience & persistence
softSkills.description: Reproducing intermittent bugs and running repetitive regression passes requires sustained, careful attention.

softSkills.name: Collaboration with developers
softSkills.description: QA and development work in a tight feedback loop, especially in Agile/Scrum teams shipping frequent releases.

futureSkills.name: Automation testing frameworks (e.g. Selenium) built on solid programming fundamentals
futureSkills.label: critical
futureSkills.description: Xây dựng bộ test tự động (vd Selenium) trên nền tảng lập trình vững, thay vì chỉ test thủ công.

futureSkills.name: Programming languages for test automation (Java, C#, Ruby, or Python)
futureSkills.label: critical
futureSkills.description: Biết ít nhất một ngôn ngữ lập trình (Java, C#, Ruby, Python) để viết và bảo trì test tự động.

futureSkills.name: SQL and XML for data-driven test validation
futureSkills.label: important
futureSkills.description: Kiểm thử dựa trên dữ liệu thực tế qua truy vấn SQL và xử lý XML.

futureSkills.name: Software design patterns, for building maintainable automation frameworks
futureSkills.label: watch
futureSkills.description: Áp dụng design pattern để xây dựng framework automation dễ bảo trì, mở rộng lâu dài.
